# luminate_site_registration_key_version (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version` (Number) Version number for the site registration key used by external secrets. Bump this value when you want to rotate the key and update the secret.

### Read-Only

- `version_changed` (Boolean) True when the version value changed compared to the previous run. Use this in the luminate_site_registration_key ephemeral so it only rotates when this is true.
